title: ‘Jensen Huang lost his mind’: how AI’s smartest man fell for the world’s oldest trick
description: Jensen Huang’s affair with a suspected spy is Silicon Valley’s worst nightmare come true The resignation this week of Nvidia’s founder and CEO Jensen Huang is one of the most astonishing corporate scandals in memory, featuring allegations of international espionage and extramarital affairs involving one of the world’s most powerful men. As investigations mount into what went wrong at the $4tn chip company, the saga may also become a milestone in the decades-long history of spies infiltrating the US tech industry. Huang admitted to being unfaithful to his wife of 41 years in a letter to employees this past weekend, following a report from the New York Times that the tech mogul had a close relationship with a woman US officials suspect of spying for China’s government. Huang resigned on Thursday after 33 years as CEO amid reports of two additional affairs with Nvidia employees, causing the world’s most valuable chip company’s stock to plummet. Continue reading...

**Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Following Scandal and Espionage Probes**
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned after 33 years following a report that he had a close relationship with a woman suspected by US officials of spying for China, alongside allegations of two additional affairs with employees. Huang admitted to infidelity in a letter to employees. The $4tn chip company's stock plummeted amid investigations into the corporate scandal.
